fee_notes: Franchise fee of $30,000 per Franchise Agreement, paid in two installments: $7,500 at signing (non-refundable except if franchisor terminates due to failure to obtain location approval within 6 months) and $22,500 at or before start of construction (non-refundable). For Area Development Agreements, a development fee is negotiable and not uniform; typically $7,500 per market in the development area, applied toward future franchise fees. Additional required pre-opening fees include $3,600 for marketing start-up materials and a $15,500 Management Training Fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay a franchise fee of $30,000 for each Franchise Agreement you sign with us. You must pay us $7,500 at the time you sign a Franchise Agreement. ... The remainder of the franchise fee, $22,500, is due to us at or immediately before the start of construction of your Restaurant and is non-refundable. ... The development fee is not uniform and is negotiable depending on the size and/or the potential number of restaurants in the development area, their location and the experience of the developer. Typically, the development fee is $7,500 for each market in the development area.
